pullRequest.title: feat: add native captures and fix complex Markdown rendering
pullRequest.body:
## Summary

- Add `artisanal_capture`: detached/versioned cell snapshots, native PNG exports, script-free HTML previews, widget captures, and an Artisanal-based CLI with a multi-width scenario gallery.
- Add an Ultraviolet software raster backend using `package:image` and explicit static TrueType fonts. No Chromium, browser automation, Flutter engine, or native font library is required.
- Fix complex Markdown rendering: nested quote borders, HTML container scope across blank lines, closed details visibility, width-bounded tables, alignment, and list/table composition.
- Fix F12 debug-overlay corruption over linked tables. Exact-cell ANSI clipping preserves complete OSC 8/SGR sequences, isolates panel pen state, and handles partially clipped wide glyphs without moving layers.
- Keep GitHub disclosure extraction out of HTML comments and literal code; preserve Markdown indentation and hard breaks.
- Add synthetic visual scenarios plus an attributed, checksum-pinned copy of Dart SDK issue 64170 as an offline bench, including real GitHub CLI F12/scrolling regressions.

## Architecture and review notes

- Raster rendering belongs to `ultraviolet`; capture/export orchestration belongs to `artisanal_capture`.
- Shared UV SGR parsing is reused for clipping state restoration rather than maintaining a divergent parser.
- Capture inputs and TrueType outlines have validation/resource limits; unsupported raster features produce explicit diagnostics.
- Generated galleries remain Git-ignored build artifacts. Fixtures, metadata, tests, and documentation are included.
- No CI workflow changes.

## Verification

Locally verified on Linux:

- **901 tests passed; 3 existing tests skipped** across Ultraviolet, Markdown, overlay/devtools, capture, and GitHub CLI suites:
  ```sh
  dart test pkgs/ultraviolet pkgs/artisanal/test/markdown \
    pkgs/artisanal/test/tui/bubbles/debug_overlay_test.dart \
    pkgs/artisanal/test/tui/program_devtools_test.dart \
    pkgs/artisanal_capture apps/github_cli -r compact
  ```
- Targeted `dart analyze` over the affected packages/code: no issues.
- Browser-safe entrypoint compilation passed for Ultraviolet and Artisanal.
- Compiled and ran the standalone native capture CLI; generated PNG/HTML galleries and inspected representative before/after images.
- Verified the issue fixture against GitHub's issue body and its recorded SHA-256.

## Current limitations

- Pixel output depends on the explicit font/profile; universal pixel identity with every terminal is not claimed.
- Complex shaping, missing glyphs/font variants, color fonts, and external terminal graphics are diagnosed rather than silently approximated. Cell captures preserve the status emoji even when the selected raster font cannot draw them.
- Long code lines remain unwrapped; a very narrow viewport can still flag code or heading overflow.
- Live PTY recording is not part of this capture CLI.

## Commits

- `5dbc14c6` — feat(capture): add native snapshots and harden Markdown rendering
- `385ab6c1` — fix(tui): preserve links and disclosure boundaries

* **New Features**
  * Added deterministic terminal captures, widget capture, native PNG/HTML export, and multi-width galleries.
  * Added native TrueType rasterization with diagnostics and configurable rendering.
  * Enhanced Mermaid sequence diagrams, shared color handling, and precise ANSI clipping.
  * Added optional native frame capture for widget testing.

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved Markdown rendering for quotes, tables, HTML, lists, and disclosures.
  * Improved overlay safety, lifecycle cleanup, error recovery, theme contrast, and resource handling.

* **Documentation**
  * Added guides, examples, changelog entries, and package documentation.

er+than%0A++%60MediaQuery%60+viewport+dimensions.+Use+%60MediaQuery%60+directly+for+viewport-based%0A++decisions%3B+unbounded+parent+axes+remain+unbounded.%0A-+%60Stack%60+now+rejects+unsupported+%60Overflow.visible%60+instead+of+silently+clipping.%0A++Use+an+ancestor+%60Overlay%60+for+content+outside+a+component%27s+bounds.%0A-+Explicit+%60Container%60%2C+%60SizedBox%60%2C+and+flex+extents+now+respect+parent+minimum%0A++and+maximum+constraints+before+laying+out+children.+A+small+application-root%0A++widget+should+use+an+%60Align%60%2F%60Center%60+host+to+loosen+the+viewport%27s+minimums.%0A-+%60ConstrainedBox%60+maximum+bounds+now+limit+a+child%27s+natural+size+rather+than%0A++forcing+it+to+fill+the+maximum.+Use+minimum+or+tight+constraints+for+expansion.%0A-+Added+%60showChrome%60+to+%60TextEditor%60+and+%60CodeEditor%60+so+workbenches+that%0A++already+provide+tabs+and+status+bars+can+use+an+unboxed+editor+surface.%0A-+Added+%60showDiagnosticBanner%60+so+unchromed+editors+retain+reusable+diagnostic%0A++feedback+by+default+while+application+workbenches+can+provide+their+own.%0A-+Updated+OpenCode+theme+selected-row+colors+to+retain+readable+text+contrast%0A++instead+of+using+the+active+border+color+as+a+row+background.%0A%23%23%23+Fixed%0A-+Prevent+layout-example+failures+on+unbounded+constraints%2C+provide+a+narrow-pane%0A++hint+for+effect+scenes%2C+and+bound+the+vertical+split-view+showcase+inside+its%0A++scrollable+page.+Add+startup%2C+keyboard%2C+and+resize+smoke+coverage+for+examples.%0A-+Preserve+layout-built+child+state+across+inherited-data+updates+and+initialize%0A++children+mounted+during+a+frame+through+the+normal+runtime+command+loop.%0A-+Align+offsets+and+painting+with+measured+child+allocations%2C+resolve+explicit%0A++bounds+before+child+layout%2C+and+retain+mounted+geometry+in+legacy+%60view%28%29%60.%0A-+Resolve+Stack+sizes+before+positioned+stretches%2C+preserve+signed+negative%0A++insets%2C+and+implement+%60StackFit.passthrough%60+constraint+forwarding.%0A-+Allocate+all+available+integer+cells+among+tight+flex+children+deterministically%2C%0A++reserving+loose+children%27s+share+caps.+Reuse+measured+child+sizes+for+offsets%0A++and+paint+instead+of+independently+redistributing+space+in+each+phase.%0A-+Resolve+container+dimensions+before+deflating+padding%2C+borders%2C+and+margins%3B%0A++clamp+excessive+margin+painting+to+the+allocated+outer+box.%0A-+Keep+offstage+navigator+entries+invisible+and+excluded+from+pointer+hit+testing%0A++even+under+tight+viewport+constraints%2C+while+preserving+their+mounted+state.%0A-+Count+list+separators+by+additional+rendered+rows%3A+a+single+newline+joins%0A++items+without+adding+a+phantom+row+to+content+extents+and+hit-test+offsets.%0A-+Dispose+the+previous+%60WidgetTester%60+program+before+remounting+and+reset%0A++terminal+capture+offsets+for+the+new+mount.%0A-+Preserve+the+caller%27s+%60ThemeScope%60+when+opening+dialogs+through%0A++%60NavigatorState.showDialog%60%2C+and+keep+the+default+modal+barrier+transparent%0A++as+documented+instead+of+painting+over+the+application.%0A-+Catch+render+failures+in+the+diagnostic+error+screen%2C+preserving+Copy+and%0A++Dismiss%2Fretry+behavior.+If+recovery+fails+too%2C+report+both+errors+in+a+bounded%0A++fallback+with+a+handled+Ctrl%2BC+quit+path.%0A-+Unregister+inherited-widget+dependents+on+unmount%2C+preventing+providers+from%0A++retaining+removed+modal%2Finput+subtrees+or+re-dirtying+them+on+later+updates.%0A-+Dispose+temporary+container%2C+stack%2C+and+scrollbar+composition+canvases%2C%0A++releasing+owned+cell+references+without+waiting+for+garbage+collection.) |

comments.body:
Addressed the current review findings in **8f45156f** and replied to/resolved all **19 review threads**.

Also addressed the two out-of-diff notes from review 5189266756:
- Updated `WidgetTester.enableRenderer` documentation to describe the native-frame opt-in and `latestNativeFrame`.
- Guarded nonpositive blockquote widths consistently in both renderers and the shared quote container; added zero/negative-width regressions.

The changes include bounded regular-file reads, source/output alias protection, bounded substring marker indexing, deterministic temporary-buffer cleanup, renderer teardown, stronger cache/font tests, cached/inline image ordering, and nested Mermaid branch depth. Related capture staging/disposal issues discovered during validation were fixed as well.

**Verification:** 3,916 tests passed with 3 skips. Analysis of artisanal, ultraviolet, artisanal_capture, artisanal_widgets, and github_cli is clean. `git diff --check` passes.

Fixed the known publish-validation metadata error by making the top Ultraviolet changelog release match its existing `0.5.1` pubspec version. No CI workflow changes or package publishing were performed. Fresh checks/review will run on the pushed commit; this PR has not been merged.


CI follow-up: **0e411828** replaces the deprecated Flutter color channel getters identified by the fresh analyzer job. After resolving the example dependencies, full workspace `flutter analyze` reports no issues and all four color/painter tests pass. Publish validation is now green. Latest test/analyzer jobs and CodeRabbit re-review are still running; the Cloudflare Workers build remains failed and requires its dashboard build log for diagnosis.
